idea.title: Daily Jump In Google Trends For Emergency Hvac Repair Signals Housing Sector Stress
idea.thesis: A sudden increase of 20% in daily search interest for emergency HVAC repair reflects consumer stress impacting home maintenance demand. Increased HVAC repair searches correlate with higher discretionary spending on home services.
data_sources: Google Trends daily search data via google_trends adapter
idea.signal_logic: Enter long XLY when daily search interest increases by 20%+ from previous day
idea.entry_exit: Entry: Enter long XLY when daily search interest increases by 20%+ from previous day Exit: Exit after 7 days or if interest drops below 10% increase
idea.position_sizing: Allocate 5% per signal, max 20% total exposure.
idea.risks: Data source instability, false positives, and regime shifts.
idea.implementation_notes: Use Google Trends daily search data via google_trends adapter via api (daily).
idea.reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Emergency home repair searches spike often due to weather changes or HVAC failures.
